name: hotfix-review
title: Hotfix review
description: Hourly from 07:37 to 23:37: when a critical pull request has no review at its head, reviews it now with the pr-review routine's method; otherwise stops in seconds.
notes: Part of the hotfix lane with the sentinel and hotfix-developer routines. Needs the pr-review routine installed (it follows its prompt) and sentinel.json in harness_dir (its gate, bin/sentinel-scan --gate review, reads the critical label and hotfix branch prefixes there).
